**As** an operator
**I want** to add an event by hand in under a minute
**so that** a venue with no website is still on the site.

**Fast is the requirement, not a nice-to-have.** These events are entered in batches, by one person,
for venues whose programme lives on Instagram. A form that takes three minutes per event means the
venues stop being covered after the first sitting.

Pair with reminders or nudges so those venues actually get checked — the recurring half of this is
what keeps the data from going stale, and it is the half most likely to be skipped.
